evidence_scope: Synthetic dependency admission on the two target hardware classes; AX post-input and gather-qmm tests run from copied, newly rebuilt test executables. No real model weights were loaded.
build_toolchain: Rust 1.97.1, Python 3.12.13, published MLX/Metal 0.32.3 wheels; test executables built on Apple M2 Ultra, 192 GiB, macOS 27.0.1
target_runtime_selection: DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH selects the isolated 0.32.3 wheel library directory and MLX_METAL_PATH selects its mlx.metallib; RUST_TEST_THREADS=1
limitations: No real-weight generation, in-path MTP-S evaluation, long-context or endurance campaign was run.
Microbench latency is not model throughput; host load was not an idle-gated certification condition.
Tests used a clean-base worktree plus the listed source changes; file and executable hashes bind the tested candidate.
